notes.title: Update for True Fear: Forsaken Souls Bundle Players
notes.notes:
We’ve recently made an important update to the True Fear: Forsaken Souls Bundle. The issue affecting access to Part 1 has now been resolved for all future buyers.

Unfortunately, several users had already purchased the bundle before we noticed the mistake. If you're one of them and are having trouble accessing Part 1, please reach out to us at support@goblinz.com — we’ll be happy to help. As a token of apology for the inconvenience, we’ll provide a free key to affected players.

Thank you for your understanding and support!
